descricao_original: This electron micrograph shows lipid droplets of varying sizes, which often coalesce into larger droplets. Lipid droplets contain neutral lipids, triglycerides and cholesterol esters, and are not surrounded by a unit membrane. Osmium tetroxide is routinely used to fix tissues for electron microscopy and its presence also imparts a grainy appearance with moderate electron density. Liver 15,000x
